attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Merrow Freeholds now occupy seven settlements.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"now\" implies a comparison with an earlier state the briefing does not give"},{"span":"The Kinn of the Long Grass maintain three settlements.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"maintain\" implies an ongoing status, which the task forbids"},{"span":"They are apparently content with the current state of affairs.","severity":"minor","reason":"an inference about the Kinn's attitude, hedged only with \"apparently\", with no basis in the briefing"},{"span":"It seems Kettle Hollow has decided to take a brief nap.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies Kettle Hollow's state is quiet, though the briefing says nothing about the colony's inner life"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin is clear but breaks the explicit ban on words like \"maintain\" and \"now\".
